STUDY 109
Gray Varsity Knit with Navy Raglan
Rights check
Source: 24993.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
wears a heathered gray cropped V-neck knit with navy
raglan sleeves, cream and red stripes, and a large red
letter S. Red cuffs peek at the wrists. She wears dark
low-rise jeans. Her expression is calm and direct. A
plain white backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of
heather gray, navy, and crimson. Collegiate and cozy,
in the style of a college knitwear catalog.
Collegiate, cozy, crisp
WORKING NOTES
- The gray body and red cuffs are the signature colors.
- Keep the cropped length for a streetwear look.
